name: browser-automation-studio
description: Browser Automation Studio CLI surface. Single source of truth for command groups, flag shapes, governance metadata, and proto-method bindings. Cross-validated at test time against generated Connect service descriptors (see cli/capture/manifest_proto_test.go). Manifest-driven command dispatch is being adopted incrementally per the proto+Connect migration plan; hand-coded domains continue to register through cli/domains until migrated.

groups.name: capture
groups.description: Capture screenshot/console/network/video/DOM/performance artifacts from a single page load

commands.name: capture
commands.description: Capture artifacts from a single page load

flags.name: label
flags.description: Optional label tagged onto every produced artifact

flags.name: json
flags.description: Emit raw CaptureResponse JSON instead of report

flags.name: dry-run
flags.description: Send X-Dry-Run header; server validates without producing artifacts

groups.name: scenarios
groups.description: Discover sibling scenarios on the host and resolve their HTTP ports.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List every scenario known to the local vrooli CLI, with status.

commands.name: port
commands.description: Get the primary HTTP port and resolved base URL for a scenario by name.

groups.name: tools
groups.description: Tool Discovery + Execution Protocol surface (cross-scenario agent integration).

commands.name: list
commands.description: List every tool this scenario advertises via the Tool Discovery Protocol.

commands.name: get
commands.description: Fetch the definition of a single tool by name.

commands.name: execute
commands.description: Invoke a tool with JSON arguments.

flags.name: args-file
flags.description: Path to a JSON file with tool arguments

commands.name: workflow
commands.description: Get the workflow JSON-Schema. Filter by --nodes a,b,c to keep only listed node types.

flags.name: output
flags.description: Write schema to file instead of stdout

commands.name: node-types
commands.description: List every node-type slug defined by the workflow schema.

commands.name: steps
commands.description: List CLI step definitions. Filter by --types a,b,c or restrict to CLI-supported steps with --cli-only.
